title: batch-connection
description:
Structure of each connection in the array - accepts all parameters from the /entities/ method
Must always send credential_id + code + (token OR credentials)

credential_id.description: Client's unique identifier for this credential

code.description: Name of the entity. The complete list is available with GET /entities/

token.description:
Value for custodied credentials, previously tokenized through a call
with tokenize=true. Alternative to user/password.

user.description: User (required if token is not sent)

password.description: Password (required if token is not sent)

product_types.description:
List of product types from which information is to be retrieved.
Accepts multiple values separated by commas. Default value is ALL.

only_balances.description:
Indicates whether to obtain only the balances of the products
instead of all available information

date_from.description:
Date from which transactions are requested, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
Must be a date before today.

date_to.description: Only applies to restricting by future dates for loan and confirming products, in YYYY-MM-DD format. The date must be later than today.

required_products_schema.description: Required products schema. Indicates the specific accounts or cards from which data is desired, with additional per-product configurations (only_balances, add_pdf_from_uuids, date_from). Accepts a JSON string.

add_pdf_from_uuids.description: Accepts transaction UUIDs separated by commas. Only taken into account if product_types is ALL or includes accounts. Adds the PDF document associated with each requested bank transaction.

force_historic_transactions.description: If true, forces retrieval of the full transaction history available at the entity, ignoring the date_from filter.

second_password.description: Second password or security answer, required by some entities in addition to the main password.

third_password.description: Third credential field required by some entities (e.g. PIN, card number).

contract_name.description: Contract or account alias required by some entities to identify a specific contract within a multi-contract access.
